source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this model has shot, each enemy unit that took at least one hit from its Indirect Fire weapon attacks must test for Battle-shock. An INFANTRY unit that a multiple rocket launcher attack hit subtracts 1 from that test.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
